newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Qatar foreign minister arrives in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Qatar foreign minister arrives in Bahrain.

text.p: Qatar's Foreign Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani arrived in Bahrain on Sunday in an attempt to improve strained relations between the two Gulf Arab states, diplomats said.
Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Mubarak al-Khalifa greeted Sheikh Hamad at the airport, the official Gulf News Agency reported.
Their talks would focus on "strong brotherly relations between the two countries and the latest developments in the region", it added.
Bahrain and Qatar are locked in a territorial dispute centred on small but potentially rich Gulf islands controlled by Bahrain since the 1930s but also claimed by Qatar.
Gulf Arab reconciliation efforts have failed to ease tensions between Manama and Doha.
